_about: Findings for agent-spec from these BDD tests, against <path of the spec folder, relative to this file>, each in the fields of the finding format of agent-spec's references/verification.md (id, class, severity, where, quote, evidence, pattern), for agent-spec's findings-file update mode. A test checks that each finding is here and names its rule.

findings.where: <file and id: scenarios.md SC-17; rules.md R-08>
findings.scenario: <the scenario id, or 'absent' when no scenario has the case>
findings.quote: <the exact line of the spec, or 'absent' for a Gap>
findings.evidence: <what the tests show: the scenario that has no World lines, the reference agent's stop, the variant that was not caught>
missing_lines: <file and the line the spec is missing, written out, such as World lines of the missing scenario>
findings.pattern: <the general form of the defect, so every instance can be fixed>
findings.bdd_side_ready: <what the test side already has, and what it adds once the spec has the lines above>
